scientific_integrity: The general formula follows from a principal-ideal rank proof. An independent arithmetic implementation of the ring multiplication and Gaussian elimination exhaustively checked thirteen modest finite-field configurations; those checks alone do not certify infinitely many parameters.
scientific_limitations: The exact arithmetic count concerns radical multiplication on the regular module of F_q[x,y]/(xy,x^a-y^b) for a,b>=2, not arbitrary Gorenstein connected sums, other modules, scheme multiplicities, or unindexed historical equivalents.
title: Exact Jordan spectra of two-branch Artinian Gorenstein connected sums
